claims.claim: The item is a Canon EOS 5D Mark II full-frame DSLR with a 21.1-megapixel sensor
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 2 show Canon EOS 5D Mark II badging and official Canon label, confirming model identity; the megapixel spec is a known factory spec for this model, not a condition claim.

risks.risk: Unknown shutter count / real usage history
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a menu/software readout or EXIF data of a test shot
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, near end-of-life shutter

risks.risk: Sensor or interior condition (dust, fungus, scratches)
risks.proof: A clear photo through the lens mount with mirror up, and a test photo against a plain white/blue sky showing sensor spots

risks.risk: Functionality of buttons, dials, AF system, shutter
risks.proof: A video clip showing power-on, menu navigation, dial turning, AF-on lens attached and focusing, and shutter firing

risks.risk: Battery, charger, memory card not confirmed included
risks.proof: A photo showing battery, charger, and memory card laid out next to the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no accessories

risks.risk: No lens, strap, or case included
risks.proof: Photo or statement confirming what accessories are bundled

risks.risk: LCD screen cosmetic condition (scratches, dead pixels)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the screen powered on showing an image or test pattern
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen condition unknown, assume wear

risks.risk: History of repairs or part replacements
risks.proof: Service receipts or a close-up of any repair stickers/seals on the body
risks.if_unproven: priced as original/unmodified unless shown otherwise

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, dials and buttons being operated, and shutter firing
Shutter count readout via menu or software
Close-up of sensor with mirror lifted and a test shot against plain sky
Photo of all included accessories: battery, charger, memory card, lens, strap, case
Close-up of LCD screen while powered on
Any repair history or service documentation
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body with no lens; seller's words are generic marketing text with no specific condition or inclusion claims, so the item must be priced at worst case (untested, body-only, possible wear) pending the listed proofs.
